description: Now: fz_binary_concat (ir_runtime.rs:1354) copies both sides into a temporary Vec, then into a new binary. acc <> "x" x1,000 = 936 shared bins, 498,420 shared bytes; x2,000 = 1,998,920 (x4, quadratic).
